column17: This ship is a survivor of the original 2nd Domain Battlegroup which served as the praetorian for the Sol system. It is a prime specimen the 2nd Battlegroup's "Adamantium Lance" doctrine, particularly exhibited by a series of radical structural modifications (performed with pre-Collapse industrial methods) which allow the mounting of larger,  and more versatile weapons,  heavier armor plating by a flat increase of %s standard units,  with only a %s reduction in speed and maneuverability. Some of the angle of its weapon system are also changed, making it more suited for head-on engagement at the cost of more exposed rear and sides. Exceptionally well-tuned energy systems increase flux throughput and capacity by %s over standard examples of this hull.
